question: Surpassing which country, India became the second-largest tea exporter in the world in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India surpasses Sri Lanka to become the second-largest tea exporter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India exported 254 million kg (Mkg) of tea in 2024, surpassing Sri Lanka to become the second-largest tea exporter worldwide.**
 
• Kenya remains the top exporter, with over 500 Mkg of tea exported in 2024.
 
• In 2023, India and Sri Lanka were neck-and-neck in exports, with around 231 Mkg each.
 
• India's tea exports in 2024 amounted to Rs 7,112 crore, with strong support from government schemes and favorable policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tea Industry in India__

 __
 
• India produces 1,400 million kg (Mkg) of tea annually.
 
• The bulk of the tea export comes from the orthodox segment.
 
• India aims to reach a 300-Mkg tea export mark by 2030.
 
 
 
• Kenya's Tea Industry__
 
 
• Kenya exported more than 500 Mkg of tea in 2024, maintaining the first position in global tea exports.
